title: Grateful Dead Live at Ivar Theater on 1966-02-25

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard captures the incendiary Feb 25 1966 Acid Test set with blistering Jerry licks, Pigpen’s soulful harp, and standout medleys like Good Morning Little School Girl → You Don’t Love Me.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as “crystal clear” and “perfect,” delivering a vivid sense of being in the room.  The performance itself is described as “on fire,” with Jerry’s licks, Pigpen’s harp and vocals, and memorable moments such as the Good Morning Little School Girl/You Don't Love Me sandwich, King Bee, Caution and an especially hot second take of Stealin'.  Overall the show is celebrated as a must‑have early‑Dead document.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently 5‑star praise for both sound quality and musical performance across many reviews; only a single low‑rating outlier that does not reflect the consensus.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers repeatedly call the mix crystal clear, crisp and “perfect” with no mention of hiss, dropouts or balance issues; the recording is described as making listeners feel like they are there.

standout_songs: Good Morning Little School Girl → You Don't Love Me (medley)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Early‑Dead set flows through blues‑rock R&B numbers with tight transitions; reviewers note a strong early “acid test” vibe and recommend skipping the first Stealin' for smoother pacing.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for blazing licks, perfect tone, and being “in that lick I love.”
